featured_reviews.review_text:
This is genuinely some of the best cake I've ever had! The ganache they use to coat every cake is incredibly delicious.
Hats off to the chef for creating such amazing cakes. Be sure to try their 'Death by Chocolate'; it's one of their bestsellers and absolutely lives up to the hype.

featured_reviews.name: Ronit Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were keen to order some cakes and cookies and hence thought of trying out from this bakery.

So we had ordered the Death by Chocolate. The cake was as the name states all chocolates cream and bread. The cake was a three-layer cake with all the layering of chocolate cream and chocolate bread as the base. The chocolate cream on top was amazing, and it had the traditional, slightly bitter taste of pure chocolate. But the cake was super amazing and fresh, and the bread was super soft. All in all, this was one of the best chocolate cakes I have ever had.

The coconut cookies had a super amazing and unique taste. The internal cookie had a strong coconut taste, and there was a topping of dark chocolate sauce. The quantity of the cookies was also incredible. All in all, the coconut cookies were unique, and the taste was delicious.

featured_reviews.name: Gosal Rebello
featured_reviews.review_text: Today I have ordered chocolate truffle cake, absolutely delicious! Rich, moist, and perfectly chocolaty, it melts in your mouth with every bite. The smooth truffle ganache and glossy glaze make it extra indulgent. Not too sweet, just pure cocoa goodness. A perfect treat for chocolate lovers—truly irresistible and satisfying! Thanks Choclato

featured_reviews.name: harshad sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience with Murlidhar Sweets, Borivali. I received a box of sweets that were spoiled and had visible fungus on them. This is not just poor quality — it's a serious health risk. Selling contaminated sweets is dangerous, especially when people trust shops like this during festive occasions.

If this is how they maintain their products, they have no business selling food to the public. It’s clear there’s a complete lack of hygiene, storage standards, and responsibility.

⚠️ A strong warning to everyone: DO NOT buy sweets from Murlidhar during Diwali or any occasion. Don’t risk your family’s health over pretty packaging and false reputation.

Shops like this must be held accountable. I hope the authorities take action before someone falls seriously ill.

I am staying in Ashovan, and had multiple incident at Adarsh Sweets - Ashokvan.

> Food / Sweets taste is okay, not great but not bad as well.

> Prices is very high compared with taste and other sweets shop options

> Service - Staffs ( on cash counter and servicing counter ) is very arrogant and roude.

> Incident
> I brought 50 samosa parcel for my society event, as if you eat on the counter you will get samosa served in paper plate, so I asked for 50 plates, which they denied
( His expression like " पार्सल समोसे के साथ कोई कागज की प्लेट फ्री मे कैसे मांग सकता हैं 😝 but still he try to do favour for me with big heart ) and replied me rudely" चाहिए तो ५ -१० प्लेट दे सकते हैं, उससे ज्यादा चाहिए तो पैसे देने पडेगे, so I went to the owner on cashier counter ( with high hopes 🤪) and got the same reply with 10x arrogance and attitude 🤣🤣,  on my further request he replied " हम सर्व्हिस देते है, प्लेट नाही" so I asked what services, owner replied "पार्सल बनाके देते है" 😜

In Ashokvan there are hardly few options, so I had multiple incidents.

Seriously very pathetic, very bad service experience, very rude staff and owner behaviour.

Not recommended at all....👎

Take care 👍🏻

featured_reviews.name: vishal sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Dessert Junction this Sunday and had a wonderful experience. We were warmly welcomed by Mr. Ritesh, who also guided us with recommendations based on our taste preferences, which added a nice personal touch.

We began with the Sizzling Brownie with Ice Cream – the brownie was soft, rich, and paired perfectly with the ice cream, making it an indulgent treat. Following his suggestion, we tried the Trio Sundae, a delightful mix of vanilla ice cream, hot chocolate sauce, brownie chunks, and dry fruits, topped with an Oreo biscuit. It was absolutely delicious and a perfect choice for chocolate lovers.

The service was quick, and the ambience felt cozy and welcoming. They also offer a range of vegetarian snacks, making it more than just a dessert spot.

Overall, Dessert Junction is definitely a go-to place if you’re craving desserts with warm hospitality.

featured_reviews.review_text:
He says She says : Bholenath - Dahisar's famous Samosa Wala .

She says : Dahisar janta has grown up eating Bholenath's Samosas and She is no different, everyone have their own beautiful-childhood memory related to these Samosas and the usual Chutney. It has always fullfilled the craving, but lately the quality of the Samosas have gone so low that you cannot even think of having another after the first unlike before. She has had like 4 Samosas in one go.

She thinks they need to focus on keeping the consistency in the taste and quality else this is not going to go very far.

He says : He has lost his love years ago, Will prefer another place but not this.
